description: This file defines a subclass 'LiteLLMProxyImageEditConfig' that customizes configuration and request handling for image edit operations routed through the LiteLLM Proxy. It extends the 'OpenAIImageEditConfig' class, providing methods to validate environment variables and construct request URLs for the proxy service.
